text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon makes an appearance on a TV 
broadcast after a long absence. She had 
been away from the front lines of racing 
for a while, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A sudden challenge was issued to the dirt 
Umamusume. If any girl capable of setting 
a "historic record" appears, she will aim 
to make a comeback targeting this year's 
Tokyo Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae had always admired Smart 
Falcon, viewing her as a legendary figure 
both as a dirt Umamusume and as an Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Competing against the admired Smart Falcon 
would surely draw massive attention. It 
was also a huge opportunity for her dream 
of putting Tomakomai on the map.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae resolved to aim for a 
historic record— the all-time highest 
number of GⅠ victories. Her sights were 
firmly set on challenging Smart Falcon!
